cues.zh: 在我了解贝塞尔曲线和样条之前
cues.en: Before I knew about bézier curves and splines

cues.zh: 我对曲线的理解非常基础
cues.en: my idea of a curve was very basic

cues.zh: 要么是经典的 y=x²-1
cues.en: It was either the classic y=x²-1

cues.zh: 要么是一段圆弧
cues.en: or a circular arc

cues.zh: 但那些能向任意方向延伸、能绕圈的曲线
cues.en: But curves that could move in all directions that could do loops

cues.zh: 以及各种形态，对我来说仍是个谜
cues.en: and all sorts of things, were still a mystery to me

cues.zh: 可一旦你开始拆解这些曲线的构造方式
cues.en: But once you start unraveling the construction of these curves

cues.zh: 把它们串联起来构成样条的想法就自然而然浮现了
cues.en: the idea of chaining them together to form splines, come naturally

cues.zh: 它让你能以计算上非常优雅的方式定义一条路径
cues.en: They let you define a path in a way that is computationally very elegant

cues.zh: 曲线的切线和法线方向等属性让你可以给物体定向
cues.en: Properties like the tangent and normal directions of the curve let you orient objects

cues.zh: 或在每个点周围构建一个坐标空间
cues.en: or construct a coordinate space around each point

cues.zh: 这对生成程序化几何体非常有用
cues.en: which is very useful for generating procedural geometry

cues.zh: 你可以基于曲率半径来分析这些曲线
cues.en: You can analyze these curves based on their radius of curvature

cues.zh: 找出它们转向的方向和速率
cues.en: find what direction they're turning and at what rate

cues.zh: 你可以解析地求出它们的包围盒
cues.en: You can analytically evaluate their bounding box

cues.zh: 这在许多优化问题中很有用，比如做相交检测时
cues.en: which is useful in a lot of optimization problems, such as when doing intersection tests

cues.zh: 我们接下来会看看如何计算其中的一些东西
cues.en: We're going to take a look at how to calculate some of these things

cues.zh: 以及它们如何共同构成我所认为的
cues.en: and how they collectively make up what I consider to be

cues.zh: 贝塞尔曲线之美
cues.en: The Beauty of Bézier Curves

cues.zh: 贝塞尔曲线，更广义地说样条，在游戏中无处不在
cues.en: Bézier curves, and more generally, splines, are ubiquitous in games

cues.zh: 你很难找到任何动画
cues.en: You'd be hard-pressed to find any animations

cues.zh: 比如这个沿路径移动的摄像机
cues.en: such as this camera moving along a path

cues.zh: 是*不*基于样条的
cues.en: that are *not* based on splines

cues.zh: 这类路径随处可见，不只是用于动画
cues.en: These types of paths are everywhere, not just for animations

cues.zh: 但也能沿着路径生成3D模型
cues.en: but also 3D models generated along a path

cues.zh: 比如这条过山车轨道，你可以通过弯曲、扭转和延伸来操控它
cues.en: such as this rollercoaster track that you can manipulate by bending twisting and extending it

cues.zh: 我也把它们用在自己的游戏Flowstorm里，用来生成你滑行其上的平滑弯曲轨道
cues.en: I also use them in my own game Flowstorm to create the smooth curved track you slide on

cues.zh: 关卡编辑器明确允许你创建样条中的相连曲线
cues.en: The level editor explicitly allows you to create connected curves in a spline

cues.zh: 并让你控制贝塞尔曲线手柄
cues.en: and lets you control bezier curve handles

cues.zh: 用过Photoshop钢笔工具的人可能会觉得这些很熟悉
cues.en: which, might look familiar to those of you who have used the pen tool in Photoshop

cues.zh: 那么，如何创建贝塞尔曲线呢？
cues.en: So how do you create bezier curves?

cues.zh: 假设你有两个点：P0和P1，由一条线段连接
cues.en: Let's say you have two points: P0 and P1 connected by a line segment

cues.zh: 现在想象在这两个点之间有第三个点P
cues.en: Now imagine a third point P between these two points

cues.zh: P的位置可以用所谓的t值来描述
cues.en: The position of P could be described by what is called a t-value

cues.zh: 一个0到1之间的值，类似于百分比
cues.en: a value between 0 to 1, similar to a percentage

cues.zh: t值为1时它移到P1，t值为0时它移到P0
cues.en: where t-values at 1 moves it to P1 and t-values at 0 moves it to P0

cues.zh: 而中间的任何值都是两者之间的混合
cues.en: and any values in between are a blend between the two

cues.zh: 这个函数叫作线性插值，简称lerp
cues.en: This function is called linear interpolation or lerp for short

cues.zh: 数学上，你可以把它写成(1-t)P0*tP1
cues.en: Mathematically, you can write it as (1-t)P0*tP1

cues.zh: 那么，如果我们再加一个点呢？
cues.en: Now, what if we add another point?

cues.zh: 我们现在有两个插值点，分别位于两条线段上
cues.en: We now have two interpolated points one on each line segment

cues.zh: 根据我们之前看到的同一个 t 值，在各自的线段上进行“线性插值”
cues.en: "lerping" on their respective line based on the same t-value we saw earlier

cues.zh: 然后我们可以用另一条线段连接这两个点
cues.en: We can then connect these two points with another line segment

cues.zh: 如果我们再在这条线段上添加一个同样基于相同 t 值进行线性插值的点
cues.en: If we then add a point on that line that also lerps based on the same t-value

cues.zh: 你可以看到它沿着一条非常特定的路径移动
cues.en: you can see that it follows a very specific path

cues.zh: 这条路径就是二次贝塞尔曲线
cues.en: This path is a quadratic bézier curve

cues.zh: 但我们不必就此止步
cues.en: but we don't have to stop here

cues.zh: 如果我们再加一个点呢？
cues.en: what if we add another point?

cues.zh: 我们重复同样的过程
cues.en: we repeat the same process

cues.zh: 添加三个点
cues.en: add three points

cues.zh: 连接它们
cues.en: connect them

cues.zh: 添加两个点
cues.en: add two points

cues.zh: 连接这些点
cues.en: connect those

cues.zh: 再添加最后一个点
cues.en: and add the last point

cues.zh: 这个点现在将沿着三次贝塞尔曲线的路径移动
cues.en: and this point will now follow the path of the cubic bézier curve

cues.zh: 这种构造方法的妙处在于，无论我们使用什么点，它都成立
cues.en: what's beautiful about this construction is that it works no matter what points we use

cues.zh: 我们可以把形状改成任何样子
cues.en: We can change the shape to anything

cues.zh: 遵循同样的规则，它就会给我们这条平滑的路径
cues.en: and following the same rules it will give us this smooth path

cues.zh: 在本视频接下来的部分，我们将主要关注三次贝塞尔曲线
cues.en: We're going to focus mostly on the cubic bézier curve for the rest of this video

cues.zh: 因为它是最常见的一种
cues.en: since it's the most common one

cues.zh: 这种获取贝塞尔曲线上特定点的方法
cues.en: This particular method of getting a point in a bézier curve

cues.zh: 基于嵌套的线性插值
cues.en: based on nested lerps

cues.zh: 其中沿途的每个点都由前面各点的线性插值计算得出
cues.en: where each point along the way is calculated from lerps from the points that came before it

cues.zh: 最终形成贝塞尔曲线的路径
cues.en: eventually forming the path of the bézier curve

cues.zh: 被称为 De Casteljau 算法
cues.en: is called De Casteljau's Algorithm

cues.zh: 我个人很喜欢它，因为它的数值稳定性
cues.en: I personally love it because of its numerical stability

cues.zh: 以及它非常容易记住
cues.en: and just how easy it is to remember

cues.zh: 一路都是线性插值
cues.en: it's just lerps all the way down

cues.zh: 但我们还可以用另一种方式来理解它
cues.en: But there is another way we can interpret this

cues.zh: 我们先从写出所有 lerp 的数学公式开始
cues.en: Let's start by writing out the math for all of our lerps

cues.zh: 然后，把这个公式完全展开
cues.en: then, let's expand this formula entirely

cues.zh: 我们再给这些点加上颜色标记，方便阅读
cues.en: let's also color code the points for readability

cues.zh: 你可能会发现
cues.en: What you might be able to see is that

cues.zh: 我们可以按每个点来重新整理这个公式
cues.en: we can rearrange this formula in terms of each point

cues.zh: 首先，每个点都可以看作是从原点出发的一个向量
cues.en: First, each point can be visualized as a vector from the origin

cues.zh: 但有趣的地方就在这里
cues.en: But this is where it gets interesting

cues.zh: 它们每一个都乘以基于 t 值的四个多项式
cues.en: Each of them are multiplied by four polynomials based on our t-value

cues.zh: 这就是所有三次贝塞尔曲线的样子
cues.en: This is what they look like for all cubic bézier curves

cues.zh: 你可能会注意到，这些值在某种程度上
cues.en: You might be able to tell that the values are sort of

cues.zh: 随着 t 的变化，作为权重互相此消彼长
cues.en: trading off with each other as weights as we change t

cues.zh: 开始时，第一个权重是 1
cues.en: in the beginning, the first weight is 1

cues.zh: 但随着 t 值增大，权重会在各个点之间转移
cues.en: but as the t-value increases the values shift across the points

cues.zh: 直到最后一个权重为 1
cues.en: until the last weight has a value of 1

cues.zh: 这叫做加权和
cues.en: This is called a weighted sum

cues.zh: 其中这些权重在任意给定的 t 值下加起来都等于 1
cues.en: where each of these weights together add up to 1 at any given t value

cues.zh: 我们把这些权重应用到各点的向量上
cues.en: Let's apply these weights to the vectors of the points

cues.zh: 如你所见，它们以完全相同的方式此消彼长
cues.en: As you can see, they trade off weights exactly the same way

cues.zh: 所以把它们加在一起
cues.en: so let's add them together

cues.zh: 得到的结果和用 lerp 的行为完全一样
cues.en: What we get is exactly the same behavior as with the lerps

cues.zh: 只是对同一套数学用了不同的解读方式
cues.en: but using a different interpretation of the same math

cues.zh: 这遵循的正是我们用 lerp 得到的同一条贝塞尔曲线
cues.en: This follows the very same bézier curve we got with the lerps

cues.zh: 这叫做贝塞尔曲线的伯恩斯坦多项式形式
cues.en: This is called the Bernstein Polynomial Form of bézier curves

cues.zh: 现在我们已经把公式中的点提取出来了
cues.en: Now that we've factored out the points in the formula

cues.zh: 把这些多项式单独分离出来
cues.en: we've isolated these polynomials

cues.zh: 因为点被视为常量
cues.en: Since the points are considered constants

cues.zh: 我们可以轻松计算这些函数的导数
cues.en: we can easily calculate the derivative of these functions

cues.zh: 但它实际代表什么呢？
cues.en: but what does it actually represent?

cues.zh: 导数是曲线在给定t值处的变化率或速度向量
cues.en: The derivative is the rate of change or velocity vector at the given t-value in the curve

cues.zh: 为了看得更清楚，我们干脆把中间那条线去掉
cues.en: and for clarity let's just absolutely demolish the middle line

cues.zh: 它挡住了视线，而且通常你看到的样条曲线也都不显示它
cues.en: it's getting in the way, and quite often it's not displayed whenever you see splines anyway

cues.zh: 我觉得导数有一点特别有意思
cues.en: Something I think is really fascinating with the derivative

cues.zh: 那就是三次贝塞尔曲线的导数
cues.en: is that the derivative of the cubic bézier curve

cues.zh: 本身也是一条二次贝塞尔曲线
cues.en: is, in and of itself a quadratic bézier curve

cues.zh: 这个关系对所有贝塞尔曲线都成立
cues.en: This relationship holds for all bézier curves

cues.zh: 贝塞尔曲线的导数永远是另一条低一阶的贝塞尔曲线
cues.en: The derivative of a bézier curve is always another bézier curve of one degree lower

cues.zh: 你可以看到，当我们改变曲线形状时，导数是如何变化的
cues.en: You can see how the derivative changes as we change the shape of the curve

cues.zh: 那么它为什么有用呢？
cues.en: So why is it useful?

cues.zh: 导数是曲线的切线，这意味着如果对其进行归一化
cues.en: The derivative is tangent to the curve which means that if we normalize it

cues.zh: 我们不仅能得到切线方向
cues.en: we can not only get the tangent direction

cues.zh: 还能通过将其旋转90°得到曲线的法线方向
cues.en: but also the normal direction of the curve by simply rotating it 90°

cues.zh: 一旦我们有了切线和法线方向
cues.en: As soon as we have the tangent and normal directions

cues.zh: 就可以开始获取偏离曲线的局部坐标
cues.en: we can start getting local coordinates that are offset from the curve

cues.zh: 这是获取偏移点的关键，我们可以利用这些偏移点
cues.en: This is the key to getting offset points that we can use

cues.zh: 来生成诸如3D道路之类的物体
cues.en: to generate things such as roads in 3d

cues.zh: 但如果我们再次求导会发生什么呢？
cues.en: But what happens if we derive it again?

cues.zh: 一阶导数可以看作是点的速度
cues.en: The first derivative can be considered the velocity of the points

cues.zh: 所以如果我们将这个想法扩展到二阶导数，那就是点的加速度
cues.en: so if we extend this idea to the second derivative that would be the acceleration of the point

cues.zh: 换句话说，就是速度的变化率
cues.en: in other words the rate of change of velocity

cues.zh: 正如我之前提到的，速度可以可视化为二次贝塞尔曲线
cues.en: As I mentioned before, the velocity can be visualized as a quadratic bézier curve

cues.zh: 同样地，加速度可以可视化为线性贝塞尔曲线
cues.en: Similarly, the acceleration can be visualized as a linear bézier curve

cues.zh: 它只是一个线段，或者我们可以直接称之为lerp
cues.en: which is simply a line segment or we could just call it a lerp

cues.zh: 但我们还可以更进一步
cues.en: But we can go one step further

cues.zh: 三阶导数称为加加速度或急动度，表示加速度的变化率
cues.en: The third derivative is called jerk or jolt and represents the rate of change of acceleration

cues.zh: 对于三次贝塞尔曲线，急动度只是一个点
cues.en: For the cubic bézier curve, jolt is simply a point

cues.zh: 换句话说，它是一个二维常量
cues.en: In other words it's a two-dimensional constant

cues.zh: 如果我们让t从0到1做动画
cues.en: If we animate t from zero to one

cues.zh: 你或许能看出它们是如何相互牵引的
cues.en: you can perhaps see how they are all pulling on each other

cues.zh: 当它们沿曲线移动时
cues.en: as they move through the curve

cues.zh: 那么我为什么要讨论所有这些导数呢？
cues.en: So why am I talking about all of these derivatives?

cues.zh: 利用速度和加速度……
cues.en: Well, using the velocity and acceleration...

cues.zh: （不要这个加加速度，把它去掉）
cues.en: (not this jerk let's remove it)

cues.zh: ……我们可以计算出一个有趣的属性，叫做曲率
cues.en: ...we can calculate a fascinating property called curvature

cues.zh: 曲率可以用一个出奇简单的公式来表达
cues.en: Curvature can be expressed with a surprisingly simple formula

cues.zh: 不仅适用于贝塞尔曲线，也适用于像这样的任意参数曲线
cues.en: not just for bézier curves but for any parametric curves like this

cues.zh: 我们取速度和加速度之间的行列式
cues.en: We take the determinant between the velocity and the acceleration

cues.zh: 再除以速度的立方
cues.en: divided by the speed cubed

cues.zh: 这就得到了曲率，通常用 κ（kappa）符号表示
cues.en: This gives us curvature usually denoted with a κ (kappa) symbol

cues.zh: 曲率大致表示曲线在任意给定点的弯曲程度
cues.en: Curvature roughly represents how bent the curve is at any given point

cues.zh: 如果曲率为 0，曲线就是平的
cues.en: If the curvature is 0, the curve is flat

cues.zh: 曲率离 0 越远，弯曲得越紧
cues.en: The further away the curvature is from 0, the more tightly bent it is

cues.zh: 现在，它所用的单位可能有点让人困惑
cues.en: Now, the unit this is expressed in is perhaps a little confusing

cues.zh: 我喜欢把它理解为弧度每米，
cues.en: I like interpreting it as radians per meter,

cues.zh: 但你也可以把曲率理解为半径的倒数
cues.en: but you can also interpret curvature as reciprocal radius

cues.zh: 也就是说，与它具有相同曲率的圆的半径的倒数
cues.en: That is, the reciprocal of the radius of a circle with the same curvature

cues.zh: 这意味着我们可以计算所谓的密切圆的半径
cues.en: This means we can calculate the radius of what's called the osculating circle

cues.zh: 如你所见，密切圆的曲率与曲线的曲率相匹配
cues.en: As you can see, the osculating circle's curvature matches that of the curve

cues.zh: 让我们看一个更有趣的例子
cues.en: Let's look at a more interesting example

cues.zh: 这里，曲率一开始是负的，用青色标为蓝色
cues.en: Here, the curvature starts out being negative marked blue in cyan

cues.zh: 然后切换为正的，标为红色和黄色
cues.en: before switching over to being positive marked red and yellow

cues.zh: 曲率改变符号的点
cues.en: The point where the curvature changes sign

cues.zh: 也就是穿过零的点，叫做拐点
cues.en: as in, passes through zero, is called an inflection point

cues.zh: 在那个点上，密切圆是未定义的，因为我们不能除以零
cues.en: at that point, the osculating circle is undefined since we can't divide by zero

cues.zh: 没有任何半径能让我们得到一条直线
cues.en: and there is no radius that would give us a straight line

cues.zh: 这就是计算三次贝塞尔曲线曲率的方法
cues.en: That's how you calculate the curvature of a cubic bézier curve

cues.zh: 导数的一个可能出乎意料的用途是计算曲线的包围盒
cues.en: A perhaps unexpected use of the derivative is to calculate the bounding box of the curve

cues.zh: 包围盒在游戏开发中被广泛使用
cues.en: Bounding boxes are used extensively in game development

cues.zh: 用于优化剔除和相交测试
cues.en: to optimize culling and intersection testing

cues.zh: 比如对于一条无限直线，我们可以先检查它是否与包围盒相交
cues.en: with, say, an infinite line, we can first check if the line intersects its bounding box

cues.zh: 然后再做开销更大的曲线相交测试
cues.en: before doing the more expensive curve intersection test

cues.zh: 那么我们如何得到这个盒子呢？
cues.en: So how do we get this box?

cues.zh: 最简单的方案就是直接用贝塞尔曲线的控制点
cues.en: The naïve solution is to simply use the control points of the bézier curve

cues.zh: 这或许够用，但我们真正想要的是紧密包围盒
cues.en: This can be good enough, but what we really want is the tight bounding box

cues.zh: 在某些情况下，两者差距巨大
cues.en: In some cases, the difference between the two is huge

cues.zh: 如果你看这个包围盒，可以看到它接触曲线上的三个点
cues.en: If you look at the bounding box you can see that it's touching three points on the curve

cues.zh: 这些就是我们想找的点
cues.en: these are the points we want to find

cues.zh: 第一步，为了获得一些洞察
cues.en: The first step to give us some insight

cues.zh: 是把曲线拆成两个分量函数，分别对应 x 和 y
cues.en: is to split the curve into its two component functions, for x and y separately

cues.zh: 我们发现局部极小值和极大值恰好与我们在曲线上标记的点重合
cues.en: What we find is that the local minima and maxima coincide with the points we marked on the curve

cues.zh: 如果我们改变曲线形状，使左边的点不再属于边界
cues.en: If we then change the shape of the curve so that the left point is no longer part of the bounds

cues.zh: 局部极小值也从左侧的 x 位置图上消失了
cues.en: the local minima also disappears from the left x position graph

cues.zh: 所以这些局部极值存在于导数变号的地方
cues.en: and so these local extrema they exist where the derivatives change sign

cues.zh: 那么如果我们转而看导数
cues.en: So if we instead look at the derivatives

cues.zh: 它们的根就是 t 值，也就是我们关注的这些点所在的位置
cues.en: their roots are the t-values where we have the points we're interested in

cues.zh: 注意，并非所有点都是边界框的一部分
cues.en: Note that not all points are part of the bounding box

cues.zh: 它们只是潜在的点
cues.en: they are simply potential points
